title: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:13282:19910201:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 13282, February 1, 1991>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (57) Omitted.

(58) The Regulations on Payment of Allowances to Members of the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea and the National Academy of Arts of the Republic of Korea shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2) and (3), "Minister of Education" (former ministerial title, 문교부장관) shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of Education" (new ministerial title, 교육부장관).

(59) through (148) Omitted.
